changes.before: a good at remembering

changes.reason: 旧释只是善于记忆；坚持奔走的倡导者与顽强生长的杂草都指不轻易放弃、顽强。

changes.before: a person who is stranded (as on an island)

changes.reason: 旧释是受困者名词；第一句围巾颜色为栗红色，第二句是使人受困的动词。

changes.before: a skin sore caused by chafing
changes.after: shameless boldness; an abnormal swelling of plant tissue
changes.reason: 旧释为摩擦造成的皮肤疮；厚着脸皮的要求及橡树叶瘿瘤两句都不指皮肤病。

changes.before: n the cardinal compass point that is a 270 degrees
changes.after: toward the west
changes.reason: 旧释是西方罗盘方位的名词，而词头及两句均表示朝西的方向副词。

changes.before: a person is not easily classified and not very interesting
changes.after: lacking distinctive or interesting features
changes.reason: 旧释限定无法分类的人；楼房和汽车两句为不起眼、没有鲜明特点的形容词。

changes.before: a traditional Muslim headdress consisting of a long scarf wrapped around the head
changes.after: a head covering made by wrapping a long piece of cloth around the head or a cap
changes.reason: 旧释只标穆斯林头饰，容易把多种文化、宗教使用的缠头巾教成单一宗教标志；不从例句衣饰猜人物宗教。

changes.before: exaggerated or affected piety and religious zeal
changes.after: the degree or quality of religious belief and devotion
changes.reason: 旧释要求宗教虔诚夸大或装腔作势；调查及跨代研究用中性宗教倾向、虔诚程度，不能预设虚伪。

changes.before: n a cruel and brutal fellow
changes.after: noisy and disorderly in behavior
changes.reason: 旧释是残酷粗暴者名词；人群及酒吧两句只说明喧闹失控，不必有残酷行为。

changes.before: so badly formed or out of shape as to be ugly
changes.after: distorted or different from the usual shape
changes.reason: 旧释要求异常严重到丑陋；塑料盖变形及陶罐稍有变形不必达到严重、丑陋的程度。

changes.before: an Austrian school of art and architecture parallel to the French art nouveau in the 1890s
changes.after: formal withdrawal from a country, organization, or group
changes.reason: 旧释特指十九世纪奥地利艺术流派；两句讨论政治脱离，没有艺术运动语境。

changes.before: n large black-and-white herbivorous mammal of bamboo forests of China and Tibet; in some classifications considered a member of the bear family or of a separate family Ailuropodidae
changes.after: a black-and-white bear native to China that feeds mainly on bamboo
changes.reason: 旧释仍把大熊猫所属科写成不确定，也笼统列西藏分布；官方动物园明确熊类及中国中南部山地分布，保留简短现代辨识，不沿用过时分类悬置。

changes.before: the charred portion of a candlewick
changes.after: powdered tobacco used especially by inhaling through the nose; to put out a flame, usually with out

changes.before: v harass with persistent criticism or carping
changes.after: arousing strong desire or interest, sometimes by seeming out of reach
changes.reason: 旧释为持续批评、挑剔地骚扰；香气及预告片都指诱人、勾起兴趣。

changes.before: a whip used to inflict punishment (often used for pedantic humor)
changes.after: something that causes widespread suffering or trouble
changes.reason: 旧释为惩罚用鞭，附迂腐幽默限定；无家可归及腐败两句均指造成苦难的祸害。

changes.before: commiserates with someone who has had misfortune
changes.after: a person who supports a cause or shares another person’s feelings
changes.reason: 旧释只说对不幸者表示怜悯；运动及团体支持者两句都不要求有人遭遇不幸。

changes.before: the whiteness that results from removing the color from something

changes.before: victorious
changes.after: not having lost a contest or suffered a defeat
changes.reason: 旧释victorious等同获胜，未说明没有败绩；不败也可包含平局，改为未输的辨识义。

changes.before: archaic terms for a wedding or wedding feast
changes.after: relating to a bride or wedding, or intended for a newly married couple

changes.before: a large digital computer serving 100-400 users and occupying a special air-conditioned room

changes.before: dip a foot or hand briefly into a liquid
changes.after: to take a casual or occasional interest in an activity, usually with in

changes.before: a member of the Industrial Workers of the World
changes.after: unsteady and likely to move from side to side
changes.reason: 旧释误取大写Wobbly的工会成员名称；椅子与腿两句均表示摇晃不稳。

changes.before: someone who makes conjectures without knowing the facts
changes.after: a person who buys assets hoping to profit from changes in their value
changes.reason: 旧释是没有事实依据的推测者；房地产及画作两句为希望资产升值而购买的投机者，不据同形义把投资当猜谜。

changes.before: someone who sells men's clothes
changes.after: a person or business that supplies clothing or equipment, especially for outdoor activities
changes.reason: 旧释只指男装销售者；两句为帐篷、睡袋及徒步装备供应，既不限男子，也不限服装。

changes.before: any of various large ancient Greek coins
changes.after: a large medal worn or displayed as an ornament; a round decorative panel
changes.reason: 旧释只指古希腊大钱币；项链纪念章及入口圆形浮雕都没有古希腊钱币信息。

changes.before: strabismus in which one or both eyes are directed outward

changes.reason: 旧释为外斜视；餐馆烤鱼及湖中钓鱼两句明确北美淡水食用鱼，不把同形医学义当食物定义。

changes.before: n a crime less serious than a felony
changes.after: a violation of a rule, agreement, or law
changes.reason: 旧释以比重罪轻的犯罪作定义；裁判违规及学校作弊不必构成犯罪，改为违反规则或法律的通常义。
